Those terms (https://berean.bible/terms.htm, dated April 30, 2023, read 2026-10-27) say: "The Berean Bible and Majority Bible texts are officially dedicated to the public domain as of April 30, 2023." and "All uses are freely permitted." They do not itemize the interlinear glosses; applying the dedication to them is an inference. The 2026-10-27 release check (spec-chirho/research-chirho/26-10-27-release-license-check-chirho.md) found no current rights claim on the interlinear's own pages (interlinearbible.com, which shows a "Free Licensing" link, and the biblehub.com interlinear).
